name: bk-lite-dev
install:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; fi
uv python install 3.12
sudo apt-get update -y
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential unixodbc-dev default-jre-headless pkg-config
if [ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ]; then . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh"; nvm install 24; nvm use 24; fi
corepack enable
corepack prepare pnpm@11.20.0 --activate
( cd server && uv sync --all-groups --all-extras --python 3.12 )
if [ ! -f server/.env ]; then printf '%s\n' 'DEBUG=True' 'SECRET_KEY=cursor-cloud-dev' 'DB_ENGINE=sqlite' 'DB_NAME=:memory:' 'ENABLE_CELERY=true' 'MINIO_ENDPOINT=127.0.0.1:9000' 'MINIO_ACCESS_KEY=dev' 'MINIO_SECRET_KEY=dev' 'MINIO_USE_HTTPS=false' > server/.env; fi
( cd web && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile )
( cd agents/stargazer && uv sync --all-groups --all-extras --python 3.12 )
( cd webchat && npm ci )
